note: FORMS product videos on the pack pages (scripts/lib/product-videos.mjs). One entry per video, keyed by its slot: trade (trade pack pages), builder (builder packs), high-risk (specialist packs), subscription (subscriptions page). Until a video is published leave youtube_url empty: a preview build shows a placeholder in its slot, a production build shows nothing. To publish one, paste its YouTube link as youtube_url and set upload_date (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it went up); title and description are already filled in; duration (e.g. PT1M30S) is optional. Rebuild after a change; the storefront also needs a restart (its CSP opens youtube-nocookie.com for these videos).
